newsitem.title: USA: Service Merchandise buys back notes.
newsitem.headline: Service Merchandise buys back notes.

text.p: Service Merchandise Co In said it will launch a tender offer for all of its outstanding $100 million aggregate principal amount 8 3/8 percent senior notes Due 2001.

It said it will pay $980 per $1,000 principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest to the tender date, consisting of $970 per $1,000 principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest for tendered notes and $10 per $1,000 principal amount for Noteholders providing their consent by August 1, 1997.
The offer expires on August 15, 1997, it said.
